verdict.rationale: Entra ID's directory is exposed through the documented Microsoft Graph REST endpoint, and there is a documented operation to list user objects, so the core of programmatic directory access is evidenced. The pack does not document the other parts of the story, and the SCIM material describes provisioning into apps rather than a directory API for developers. Missing for 10: groups API docs, app role assignment API docs, pagination behavior, filtering/query parameters, auth/permission model for the API, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the directory is fully programmable — documented REST APIs for users, groups, and app assignments with pagination, filtering, and clear auth

citations.quote: The Microsoft Graph API offers a single endpoint, https://graph.microsoft.com, to provide access to rich, people-centric data and insights in the Microsoft cloud
